evidence.source_statement: For each in-scope upstream C capability in an authorized C-to-Rust port, record its Rust implementation or replacement mapping, track implementation and verification status, and explicitly identify missing, incompatible or unverified behavior.
source_conditions: An upstream baseline and the port's in-scope feature set have been identified.
source_exceptions: Out-of-scope features and accepted deviations remain explicitly recorded and are not silently reported as implemented.

interpretation.situation_scope: Relationships describe relevant contexts, not exhaustive triggers or narrower rule applicability.
interpretation.intent_semantics: Intent relationships describe inferred underlying outcomes; normative authority remains with the original rule.
interpretation.effective_rules: No rule, rule profile, or execution instruction is altered by linking.
